tips.text: Tap the Fish stall to buy your first Pebble Damsel. It's on the house!
Partners earn more together. Put the Clownfish in the same carriage as the Carpet Anemone.
Tap a carriage to feed it. Its fish earn ×3 for a few seconds.
Double-tap a carriage to step inside, then tap the pencil and drag in a plant.
Passengers post wishes on the Requests board. Meet them and they'll reward you next visit.
